description_en: Retrieves the list of APIs that have been authorized to other users
description_zh: 调用ListDataServiceApiAuthorities获取授权给他人的API列表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-data-service-api-authorities --project-id 10000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --tenant-id 10001 --api-name-keyword '我的API名称' --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataServiceApiAuthorities

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大50条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keyword in the API name. This parameter is used to filter APIs whose names contain the specified keyword
parameters.help_zh: API名称的关键词，通过过滤获取API名称包含该关键词的API
parameters.name: api_name_keyword
